HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
• 6 Bedrooms
• Accommodates 18 Guests
• SQFT: 4594
• Stories: 3
• Elevator
• Gated Home with Endless Gulf Views
• Heated Private Pool & Sun Deck (Pool can be heated for an additional $90 per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
• Bocce Ball Court & Corn Hole
• 6 seater Golf Cart & 6 adult bikes
• Outdoor Summer Kitchen
• Parking for 5 Cars
• Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31

Welcome to Belle la Mer “Beautiful Sea” offering the best of authentic original Inlet Beach, the easternmost scenic 30A beach community of south Walton County Fl. This home boasts of premium quality, thoughtful versatility, spaciousness inside and outside, resort-like atmosphere, ideally located for peaceful relaxation, and easy walking/bike access to upscale restaurants and shopping describe what attracts so many discerning beach vacationers to Belle la Mer!

Imagine the emerald water and powdery white sand of the most beautiful beaches in the world just a one-minute stair-free stroll outside your front door! Low density beach abounds at this unique junction of a small county park and Camp Helen State Park. Dine or enjoy coffee with incredible Gulf views on the expansive second and third floor decks.

Given the prized location of this home, guests enjoy peaceful scenic landscape along the beach boardwalks, lifeguards, quality restroom, shower and foot wash facilities, snorkeling at an artificial reef located 300 yards right off the beach. Bonfire and beach dining concierge services are perks. No crowded beaches at this amazing site.

Whether you are a small family, group of six couples, or larger gathering of up to 18 people, Belle la Mer will effortlessly accommodate everyone. Offering 5000 sqft indoors as well as unusually large gated outdoor space tasteful relaxation awaits your arrival! Belle la Mer features a three stop elevator, five beautifully appointed king bedrooms with private bathrooms adorned with floor to ceiling marble showers. A sixth bedroom features another private bathroom, four custom built in adult size bunk beds, as well as a luxury queen sleep sofa. Drift asleep on a luxury queen sleep sofa overlooking the Gulf from another third floor bedroom.

The generous primary living/dining/ kitchen area is on the second floor to take advantage of amazing Gulf views from floor to ceiling sliding doors. Everyone eats together at a large table, massive marble island, and large peninsula bar. The well-appointed kitchen, butler pantry, and bar area have two dishwashers and refrigerators, warming drawer, convection microwave, gas stove/oven, beverage cooler, and ice-makers to accommodate the most discriminating chef. After dinner enjoy a movie on our 85-inch TV/Sonos system with plenty of comfortable seating for all.

After a game of bocce ball and lounging on front porch rockers head to the cabana/pool area out back. The huge 35ft saltwater pool and sundeck are surrounded by comfortable seating. A cabana, or indoor/outdoor living space has a 20ft ceiling, kitchen, laundry, half bath, and features another 85in tv/Sonos system so you can dine outside and watch the big game from the pool! Celebrate the win by dancing under the disco ball and pin lights.... Your own nightclub on site!

Near the pool is a Cornilleau Park ping pong table, synthetic turf area for yoga, corn hole etc, large Blaze natural gas grill and fire pit too. There is parking for up to five vehicles as well as a six seater golf cart provided. Belle la Mer truly presents as a luxury resort; a place where cherished beach vacation memories are created!

ABOUT THE AREA:
Your own private, serene, oasis near the hustle and bustle of Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and beyond on scenic 30A just a pleasant walk or bike ride away. Stock up at either Publix or Winn Dixie grocery stores just a five minute drive or have groceries delivered to Belle la Mer. Walk/bike/or take golf cart to at least 20 excellent restaurants as well as numerous shops at
Rosemary Beach, 30Avenue, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Numerous festivals and the weekly Rosemary Beach Sunday farmer market are fun to explore. Visit Pier Park in West Panama City Beach, try deep sea fishing, venture out to Shell Island, golf at several fine local courses, or simply relax and enjoy all that luxurious Belle la Mer at Inlet Beach has to offer!

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
* Rare, almost new (2021), spectacular, Gulf view property on a small park so close to the beach (1 minute walk- no stairs). Very high end beach front community.
* Versatile, spacious, private, gated, 3 story layout with elevator; 12ft-16ft ceilings; large cabana with 20ft ceiling; custom furnishings; extraordinary beach artwork created by owner.
* 5 king ensuite; 1 queen ensuite also with 4 custom bunk beds; 1 queen bedroom. Sleeps up to 18 guests in beds.
* 35ft saltwater heatable pool with sun deck (Pool can be heated for an additional $90 per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
* Amazing entertaining/dining spaces on the second floor and ground level.
* Massive second and third floor furnished balconies with 180 degree unobstructed Gulf views.
* Included amenities: 6 bikes, 10 beach towels, 6 seat golf cart.
* Bocce ball court, corn hole, yoga exercise turf area, ping pong, outside shower, Blaze natural gas grill, natural gas fire pit.
* Spacious easy access beach with lifeguard, artificial reef, very limited nearby public parking so lower density beach occupancy is the norm even in summertime.
* Beach bonfire, catering, kayak, surfboard rental available.
* Two 85 in tv and Sonos sound systems located in main entertainment spaces
* Large indoor/outdoor furnished living space (cabana) with kitchen, laundry, half bath by pool.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 18)
FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 8)
• Bedroom 1: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass/Tile Shower
• Bedroom 2: Bunk Bedroom with Two Twin Over Twin Bunks + Queen Sleep Sofa (sleeps 6) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Shower/Tub Combo
• Sitting Area with Bar Table
• Laundry Area with Frontload Washer & Dryers
• Game Room with Kitchen opens to Pool Deck

SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 4)
• Bedroom 3: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass/Tile Shower – Gulf Views
• Bedroom 4: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass/Tile Shower

THIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 6)
• Bedroom 5: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Soaking Tub & Walk-in Shower – Gulf Views
• Bedroom 6: Media Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa (sleeps 2) – Gulf Views
• Bedroom 7: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Glass/Tile Shower


LAYOUT
FIRST FLOOR:
• Guest Bedroom 1 & 2
• Foyer with Seating Area
• Elevator
• Laundry Area with Frontload Washer & Dryer
• Access to Game Room with Kitchen (opens up to pool deck via garage door)

SECOND FLOOR:
• Guest Bedroom 3 & 4
• Half Bathroom
• Living Room & Dining Room (Seats 8)
• Kitchen (island seats 4) Bar Area (seats 4) + Butler’s Pantry
• Outdoor Balcony with Dining and Seating

THIRD FLOOR:
• Guest Bedroom 5, 6 & 7
• Balcony Overlooking the Gulf

OUTDOOR AREA:
• Grilling Station
• Pool & Spa with Sun Deck & Lounge Chairs
• Fire Pit
• Ping Pong Table
• Outdoor Shower
• Bocce Ball Court


PARKING:
Private onsite parking for five vehicles (three in driveway and two in front parking pad). Onsite golf cart can be moved around as needed for space.

*This home is pet-friendly, if approved, and with the addition of pet fees*
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
